brief: We screened 1,307 NYC parcels and identified key actionable deals where underwriting pencils cleanly under current tax and zoning programs. This week we are prioritizing four top sites across direct private buys, a faith-owned joint venture, and a city disposition pipeline. These targets leverage 485-x tax exemptions and City of Yes UAP density to maximize equity returns.

targets.play: Develop a 7-unit residential project taking advantage of the 10-year 485-x Option C small building tax exemption.
targets.negotiation: Cap offer at max_offer of $1,047,948 against estimated land cost of $952,680, backed by 1.96 headroom.
targets.risk: Verify site condition and clear title before mailing.

targets.play: Build a 9-unit market and stabilized residential project under 485-x Option C.
targets.negotiation: Bid at or below estimated land cost of $1,195,053 up to max_offer of $1,314,558, providing 2.09 headroom.
targets.risk: Verify R6 zoning dimensional requirements and lot boundaries.

targets.play: Structure a ground-lease JV partnering with the faith-based owner as the qualified 51 percent partner under 485-x Option C.
targets.negotiation: Frame joint venture terms around estimated land value of $353,574 and max valuation of $388,931, backed by 6.54 headroom.
targets.risk: Verify institutional-owner approval and congregation board consent.

targets.play: Call the local Council member and community board to position our shop for an HPD RFP disposition of a 67-unit City of Yes UAP project.
targets.negotiation: City-owned disposition site requiring an RFP bid rather than a private purchase offer, with estimated land at $4,126,980.
targets.risk: Verify municipal sewer connection capacity and agency RFP release timeline.

process_note: All figures reflect initial screening underwriting and remain subject to full site diligence.
